text:
Maria: Sorry to ping the channel — PR #8420 is blocked by a flaky integration test in `integration/healthcheck` that's been failing for ~18h. Build: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/builds/12345 Can someone triage or trigger a rerun?

Dan: On it. Can you paste the failing log or the test name so I can start? If it's infra-related we might need eng-infra help.

Maria: ```
--- FAIL: TestStartupHealthcheck (0.47s)
    healthcheck_test.go:58: AssertionError: expected status 200, got 504
    logs: "container startup timed out after 30s; readiness probe failed"
--- FAIL
```

Kevin: Hmm that looks like startup timing. Could be noisy VM or slow network. I'll try a build retry first: /bk retry 12345

CI Bot: Build 12345 failed — 1 failing test: integration/healthcheck.TestStartupHealthcheck. Retry available.

Sophia: If retry passes, merge. If it flakes again, we should bisect the last deploys or mark as flaky (xfail) temporarily. I can take the bisect if needed.

Kevin: Rerun kicked off — https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/builds/12346

CI Bot: Build 12346 passed — all checks green :white_check_mark:

Dan: Looks green now. Maria, feel free to merge. Opening a ticket to track recurring healthcheck flakiness: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2312

Maria: merging now. I'll add a note in the PR and the ticket. Thanks y'all! :tada:

Kevin: follow-up: adding a 5s buffer to the readiness probe in a separate PR might help.

Sophia: Agree. Also adding a periodic synthetic to exercise container startup will catch regressions earlier.

Maria: good plan — creating follow-ups. Thanks everyone :pray:
